record.description: Directly inspected conceptual essay on institutions transferring archival, audit and preservation labor onto witnesses. It develops opacity as a protective boundary, the proposed justice → audit → archive → containment trajectory, custodian drift and governance architectures for safe harbor. These arguments are source claims rather than validated universal laws.
